files.data/neighborhoods.json: canonical dataset, one object per record, sorted by slug
files.data/neighborhoods.search.json: slim search index (no notes/sources/descriptions), with a normalized q field
files.data/sources.csv: one row per record x source
files.data/excluded.json: records dropped during the build and why
files.data/discover-baseline.json: names scripts/discover.mjs has already seen and that were deliberately left out (baseline 2026-09-23)
